name: GAIA
role: capability-covered evaluation subset of the 2023 validation split
license_data: gated; redistribution prohibited by the dataset's own gate terms. This manifest therefore lists TASK IDS ONLY -- no question, answer or attachment byte appears here or anywhere else in this repository.
selection_rule: Include a validation task IFF every modality it requires is SUPPORTED in ant.evaluation_suite.gaia_scope.MODALITY_SUPPORT. Concretely: include iff the task declares no attachment, OR its attachment's file extension maps to a SUPPORTED modality. Exclude otherwise. Computed from TASK-OBSERVABLE signals only (declared attachment presence and file extension).
selection_inputs_forbidden: any model's performance on the task
selection_leakage_guarantee: Structural, not conventional: gaia_subset.SubsetCandidate has no field for a reference answer or annotator metadata, so select_subset() has no parameter through which either could be threaded. `level` is carried for REPORTING only; tests/test_gaia_subset.py asserts the partition is identical when every level is blanked.
blocked_reason: HTTP 403 GatedRepoError from huggingface.co on 2026-09-17. HF_TOKEN is present and valid (whoami -> user "Xaviuer"; fine-grained token "Gaia" with canReadGatedRepos=true), and HfApi().dataset_info("gaia-benchmark/GAIA") succeeds -- but dataset_info returns PUBLIC metadata for a gated:auto repo whether or not the gate has been accepted, so its success is not a test of access. The authoritative check, GET https://huggingface.co/api/datasets/gaia-benchmark/GAIA/auth-check, returns 403: "Access to dataset gaia-benchmark/GAIA is restricted and you are not in the authorized list." The account must accept the dataset terms once, in a browser, on the dataset page. No mirror or scraped copy was sought or used.
note: NOT FROZEN. Every field above that describes the SELECTION RULE, the declared modality policy and the substrate dependency versions is real and final; every field that would describe the SELECTED TASKS is null because the split could not be read. Nulls (not zeros/empty lists) are deliberate: "not computable yet" and "computed, found none" must not share a representation. Run scripts/freeze_gaia_manifest.py once the gate is accepted -- it recomputes everything live and rewrites this file with status=frozen. require_frozen_manifest() refuses this file as-is.
